purpose: Ledger for ARENA rounds - the flywheel that measures whether a corpus defect REACHES the user's answer. Distinct from validation_rounds.json (is the doc accurate?) and pipeline_audit_rounds.json (is the machinery sound?). Protocol and invariants: audit/arena_protocol.md.
naming_note: Always cite these as 'arena round <id>'. A bare 'round N' is ambiguous across three ledgers here plus the preproc-agent's own.

rounds.question: Does a documentation defect reach the user's answer, and do the 22 MANDATEs in agent/helpers/verifiers.md change that?
rounds.design: 2x2 factorial: arm (real verifiers.md, 39049 B vs placebo stub, 505 B) x phrasing (naive, zero trigger keywords vs trigger-hitting). 8 traps (3 native + 5 seeded). Answerer pinned sonnet with tools, agentType magpie-helper. Regime varied across replicates: rep1 normal effort, rep2/rep4 low effort, rep3 docs-only (no GAMS access).
rounds.grading: FINAL: written-file substrate, 2 independent Opus graders per trap group, split rubric (ASSERTS_FALSEHOOD / OMITS_DEFAULT_CAVEAT / CORRECT_AND_COMPLETE / NOT_ELICITED) plus an un-anchored 'anything else the code contradicts' field; adjudication on disagreement. Inter-grader agreement 103/104 = 99%.

propagation_wide.definition: falsehood OR omitted default caveat; comparable to the original rubric

regime_effect.note: low effort degrades COMPLETENESS (omitted caveats); no code access degrades CORRECTNESS (outright falsehoods)

arm_null.note: genuine null, not a floor - both arms well off zero (5/52, 7/51)

class_effect.note: T5 and T6 both elevated; the class effect is real

item_effect.note: propagation is BOTH class-specific and item-specific

mechanically_certain_defects.status: EXPLORATORY - not pre-registered, defect definition widened after a first look. Lead for a powered replication, not a finding.

scope_limits: Every question was authored to hit a known defect. These are ADVERSARIAL rates; the base rate on ordinary questions is unmeasured and certainly lower.
The ablation removed verifiers.md but left AGENT.md, which already mandates citing/precision/non-fabrication. It measured the MARGINAL value of the procedural layer, NOT 'do instructions work'.

12 mechanical surface measures are flat across arms (all p > 0.45) including within rep1 alone, while the same measures move 2-7x under regime change. Tested against MANDATE 16 specifically (full-path vs bare-basename citation): 60.9% vs 53.9%, p = 0.299 - directional, unresolved.
Answerer pinned to one model. Nothing here generalises across models.
instrument_defects_found: Arena built inside a git work tree injected 0 of 5 hunks while looking plausible (fixed: build git-free).

SUBSTRATE DIVERGENCE: graders read the workflow return value, the re-adjudication read the written files; 70% of cells differed, 12 were graded on 21-109 char stubs. Invalidated a full day's conclusion. See arena_1a_substrate_defect.md.
Canary fidelity gate collapsed at low effort (the measured cell) and was refused as a suspected prompt injection by 10 of 104 answerers. Replaced by parsed tool_use inputs.
Anchored rubric scored answers CORRECT while they fabricated elsewhere; the un-anchored field caught 6/6 mechanically certain defects it missed.

Four EXTRACTION defects found by an exhaustive precision census (2026-08-01), each now carrying a regression control. Largest: a citation's lookbehind trimmed only on sentence punctuation, so in a bulleted source list every item inherited the previous item's identifiers - 9 of the first 14 findings adjudicated. Also: severity labels are INVERTED relative to precision (citation_identifier_absent, labelled 'major', is 20% precise; citation_off_by_small, labelled 'minor', is 100%). Do not gate CI on the 'major' class.
open: Precision MEASURED 2026-08-01 by exhaustive census (not a sample): citation 7/13 = 54%, non-default-realization 9/13 = 69%. See audit/checker_precision_census_2026-08-01.md. Single-rater, not independently re-derived.

SUPERSEDED COUNT: the '43 certain-class citation findings' figure was inflated ~4x by four extraction defects (bulleted source lists leaking identifiers across items; set member lines cited under the set name; filenames admitted as claimed identifiers; flat markdown sections). True post-fix count over the same 105 answers is 9. Any rate computed off 43 is void.
Triage fan-out over the remaining 7 citation + 9 non-default true positives - none acted on until independently re-derived.
A powered replication of the fabrication arm effect needs ~83 answers per arm.

RECALL + COVERAGE MEASURED 2026-08-01: 160/160 = 100% recall on the subset the citation checker evaluates, but it evaluates only 350/800 = 43.8% of citations (it silently skips any with no claimed identifier). 46% of skips are structurally unverifiable. Widening the lookbehind was MEASURED at ~20% precision on a random sample of 10 and REJECTED. Ceiling is ~44% coverage at high precision; going higher needs a different predicate, not a wider window.
